note: Runnable units, one per shape a runner must tell apart: a test that passes, a test that fails, a file with no test, a file that does not compile, and a unit that sets no work.

units.title: Greeting
units.note: Its test PASSES against the file as shipped.

units.title: Totals
units.note: Its file runs, and its test FAILS against the file as shipped.

units.title: Hello
units.note: A file and NO test: the practice is ungraded, which is not a failure.

units.title: Area
units.note: Its file does not COMPILE, so the first failure ends the run before its test.

units.title: Reading on
units.note: Reading only: no practice document at all.
